description: Research intake (decision 0044): one work seat reads the articles a commission names or finds and proposes registry entries; one boxed gate proves the registry still parses, every citation resolves, and the operator's cap of ten entries per run held. Nothing ships from this table: the entries reach main through a delivery run, and the classifications stand as proposals until the operator rules them.

rules.reason: Entries were written; the registry test and the cap decide whether they are well-formed proposals.
Every article was already in the index; the gate still proves the tree is as it was.
The commission or a source could not be read as given; the question is in the notes for the operator.
The entries do not parse, a citation does not resolve, or more than ten were written; the report names which. Nothing is proposed until it does.
Well-formed proposals on a branch. The operator reads, rules the classifications, and delivers them.
